reddit.title: New Material Management System in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share a significant update in Provincia! Our new materials management system replaces the previous cost badges with a detailed materials sheet for each build tile. Now, when you select a paid tile, you'll see a clear breakdown of the materials needed, including what's stored and what's required, with any shortages highlighted. This change aims to enhance your building experience and make planning your colony much smoother. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Introducing the New Materials Management System!
steam.body: We're excited to announce a major update to Provincia! Our new materials management system replaces the old cost badges with a detailed materials sheet for each build tile. This feature allows you to see exactly what materials are stored and what is required at a glance, making it easier to plan your colony effectively. Discover all the details about this update and how it will improve your gameplay: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
